rules.title: Overhead water tank in North
rules.explanation: A heavy overhead tank is traditionally preferred in southern or western sectors.
rules.practical_impact: Provides traceable Knowledge coverage for overhead water tank placement.
rules.architectural_note: Relocation or load changes require structural-engineering approval.
rules.existing_home_note: Prevent leakage and ensure the supporting structure is professionally inspected.
rules.source_note: Belief-based guidance; interpretations and schools may vary.
